essence: The verse links worship and oblation with namah and svaha endings.
The oblation is to be given from door to seat-end, especially.
The measure is hen-egg size, then half, then half again.
In the four-doored assembly, oblation goes to Bhṛṅgi and Vināyaka.
The afterward cow-oblation is given to the goddess, Caṇḍa, and Soma.
